source_text: EAST Tokamak Experiments Exceed Plasma Density Limit, Offering New Approach to Fusion Ignition.
UKAEA completed the fifth series of experiments with its MAST Upgrade fusion machine.
The fifth series produced more than 1,100 fusion plasmas.
China has built and is building over 1 million tons per year of renewable hydrogen production capacity.
Electrolysis water hydrogen production remains the mainstream technology route.
Europe's first large-scale 10 MW PEM electrolysis hydrogen production commercial project has been put into operation in Germany.
The UK completed a real-world seawater direct electrolysis hydrogen production trial at Portland Port.
